riskMatrix.risk: Multi-account bonus exploitation (same user opening multiple accounts for welcome bonuses)
riskMatrix.existingProtection: Identity hash deduplication (assertIdentityHasNotClaimedPromo on PAN/Aadhaar) + device fingerprinting
riskMatrix.gap: Unverified users prior to KYC could attempt multiple claims if unlinked
riskMatrix.recommendedFix: Require phone verification / SMS OTP before claiming signup promo codes

riskMatrix.risk: Referral loops & self-referral (User refers their own secondary account)
riskMatrix.existingProtection: Self-referral check (userId !== referrerId) + PAN/Aadhaar clash check + IP collision detection

riskMatrix.risk: Free bet double-spending across concurrent bet placement requests
riskMatrix.existingProtection: Database row lock (FOR UPDATE) on wallets.freebet_balance during bet placement transaction

riskMatrix.risk: Direct withdrawal of promotional bonus funds without wagering turnover
riskMatrix.existingProtection: Withdrawal engine checks balance (Cash) only; getWithdrawableAmount strictly excludes bonus_balance and locked_deposit_balance
